answer: Each identity stakes 70 credits and files a commit-reveal hash in the onyx ledger before the task opens. The holder then has one hour to reveal preimage and fresh work; an auditor's ivory seal confirms it. A past-epoch relic commitment cannot match new work. A rented or mismatched reveal burns the bond. First commit burns 45, the k-th from one funding key 45+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 2,542,500 against a 40,000 pool; honest agents pay 45 once.
